capabilities: create handwritten notes as PDFs from paper templates
open vault PDFs in external editors for stylus annotation
embed and reference handwritten notes in Markdown files
store notes as PDFs for long-term format compatibility
disambiguation: Despite the name, the plugin does not render handwriting itself; it creates and embeds PDF note files that you edit in an external PDF editor.
extras: An external PDF editor is mandatory and unsupported editors are the main cause of issues; mobile support is limited because not all mobile apps edit files directly; templates may not sync via Obsidian Sync and must be copied manually; installation is manual via release files.
intentEvidence: Unlike the Excalidraw plugin, this plugin supports long stylus-based notes without performance issues.
motivation: The author wants handwritten notes to last, prioritizing PDF storage so notes stay portable and readable independently of any app (File Over App).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create handwriting-based notes or annotate PDFs with a stylus, and existing drawing plugins struggle with long stylus notes.

relations.evidence: Unlike the Excalidraw plugin, this plugin supports long stylus-based notes

requires.name: external PDF editor (e.g. Xodo, PDF Annotator, Adobe Acrobat)

summary: Handwritten-note plugin that creates stylus notes stored as PDFs and opens them in external PDF editors for writing and annotation.
